Project Studies Interdisciplinary Projects (IDP)

Project studies

Students in the bachelor’s programs Bioeconomy and TUM-BWL have the opportunity to conduct their project studies in cooperation with a company or agency at the Professorship of Economics. The project is carried out with a team of 2-5 people and lasts for a period of 3-6 months, depending on whether the students complete the project part-time or full-time. In the bachelor’s program Bioeconomy individual project studies are possible. If there are currently no offered projects, you can also submit an unsolicited application with a proposed topic and a cooperation partner from the industry or a government agency.

Please send us your applications for a project study in PDF format with the usual application documents (short cover letter, CV, excerpt of grades) by e-mail.

Currently offered projects

  • None.

Interdisciplinary project (IDP)

We offer Master students of Informatics the opportunity to conduct their interdisciplinary project (IDP) at the Professorship of Economics in research projects related to the field of Behavioral Economics. If there are currently no offered projects, you can also apply on your own initiative and we will try to develop a project idea together with you.

Please send us your applications for an IDP in PDF format with the usual application documents (short cover letter, CV, excerpt of grades) by e-mail.

Currently offered projects

  • None.
